children: US crude oil inventories rose sharply by 7.14 million barrels in the week ending September 11th, following a 300,000-barrel decline in the previous week.
Commercial crude inventories excluding the SPR have fallen by just over 41 million barrels over the past 22 weeks, while total US crude inventories are up nearly 10 million barrels year to date.
Another 400,000 barrels were released from the SPR during the week, bringing total SPR holdings to 285 million barrels.
The generally accepted operational minimum for the SPR is between 250 million and 300 million barrels.
Cushing inventories fell by 246,000 barrels, following a 300,000-barrel decline the previous week.
US production rose to 13.947 million bpd in the week ending September 4th, from 13.862 million bpd a week earlier.
Gasoline inventories increased by 1.46 million barrels, while distillate inventories gained 1.61 million barrels.

title: US Crude Stocks Surge
